name: JellyMold Companion
overview: Watch history for JellyMold and any other app.
description: A permanent record of everything each person watches and listens to on this server, readable by each person from an app. Survives media being deleted from the library; never deletes history.

versions.changelog: Phase 3: a store for each person and the household, quiz results and a household leaderboard, learned skip segments for every app, putting the resume point back after an app vanishes (Jellyfin 10.10), subtitles prepared ahead, and the home screen in one request. Includes Phases 1 and 2.
